1.web: Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.
1.asv: Jehovah reigneth; he is clothed with majesty; Jehovah is clothed with strength; he hath girded himself therewith: The world also is established, that it cannot be moved.

2.web: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
2.asv: Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.

3.web: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
3.asv: The floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.

4.web: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
4.asv: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, Jehovah on high is mighty.

5.web: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forever more.
5.asv: Thy testimonies are very sure: Holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for evermore.
